transfer.stem: Which notes correctly describe the plan, the lamp and the bird?
transfer.passage:
A visit to the wetland project
Our class visited a project supporting the conservation of local wetlands. At the entrance, the guide explained that a sustainable plan must work for people and nature. Beside the garden path stood a solar lamp. Its small information card described sunlight as a renewable source of energy.
We joined an ecology activity about how living things relate to their surroundings. From a viewing point, the guide showed us a part of the wetland that provided a home for an endangered bird. We wrote down what we had learned about its habitat.
The visitor centre also had a geology display. One panel described a volcano that had been quiet for many years. Another showed nearby fields covered in ash after an eruption. We compared the panels before returning to the path.

options.text: The plan must work for people and nature; the lamp uses solar energy; the bird is endangered, rather than already extinct.
The plan only needs to work for people; the lamp uses solar energy; the bird is endangered, rather than already extinct.
The plan must work for people and nature; the lamp uses wind energy; the bird is endangered, rather than already extinct.
The plan must work for people and nature; the lamp uses solar energy; the bird has already become extinct.

answer.display: The plan must work for people and nature; the lamp uses solar energy; the bird is endangered, rather than already extinct.
